commands.list: Who is waiting at the gate.
commands.let: Lets one member or everyone at the gate in.
commands.ban: Bans everyone waiting at the gate.

warn: {who}, that message broke the **{rule}** rule here.
dmTimeout: You were timed out in **{guild}** for {duration}. Reason: {rule}.
dmFooter: Questions go to the server staff, not to me.

slowmode.raised: Slowmode in {channel} raised to {duration}, {rate} messages in the last minute.
slowmode.restored: {hasDuration, select, yes {Slowmode in {channel} back to {duration}.} other {Slowmode in {channel} is off again.}}

raidAlert:
> [!CAUTION]
> Raid shield is up. **{joins}** joins in {seconds} seconds.
New joins wait at the gate until {until}.
raidNoGate: No gate role is set, so nobody is held. Pick one in the dashboard.
lockdownStarted: Lockdown until {until}. New joins wait at the gate.
lockdownEnded: {held, plural, =0 {Lockdown over. Nobody is left at the gate.} other {Lockdown over. **{held}** still waiting at the gate.}}
gateIncident: {hasUntil, select, yes {**{held}** held. Lockdown until {until}.} other {**{held}** held.}}
gateEmpty: Nobody is waiting at the gate.
Nobody at the gate. Quiet day.
letInAll: {count, plural, =1 {Let **1** member in.} other {Let **#** members in.}}
letInPartial: Let **{done}** of {total} in. I couldn't remove the gate role from the rest.
noGateRole: No gate role is set. Pick one in the dashboard.
banConfirm:
> [!WARNING]
> This bans **{count}** {count, plural, =1 {member} other {members}} held at the gate.
React with {ok} within 30 seconds to go ahead.
bannedAll: {count, plural, =1 {Banned **1** member from the gate.} other {Banned **#** members from the gate.}}
bannedPartial: Banned **{done}** of {total}. The rest probably have roles above mine.
